pre_outcome_amendments.reason: Correct the metadata field name from the conceptual rendered_text label to the frozen meta.jsonl field text; prompt bytes and tokenization semantics are unchanged.
Add the eight-corner intervention cube before implementation so single-component effects are not misinterpreted as unique natural indirect effects.
pre_outcome_amendments.change: factorial cube, additive response R2, and explicit intervention-side interactions

scientific_question: Do the effect-coded shared-purpose A, format-offset B, and purpose-by-format interaction C components have distinct, sign-symmetric downstream causal response signatures on held-out purpose families and payload blocks?
central_hypothesis: For h_(p,f)=mu+pA+fB+pfC, an A intervention produces a format-shared purpose-readout shift, C produces a benchmark-minus-casual purpose-readout interaction, and B produces a format-readout shift; the C interaction is larger at the geometry-selected high-C/A layer than at the low-C/A layer.

inspected: All-layer pilot80 8B observational geometry and its frozen AUC>=0.80 min/max C/A selection rule.
Full320 and pilot80 observational probe/equal-row outcomes, including negative strict controls and estimator sensitivity.
A development-only 20-item no-cue JLens intervention using non-factorial purpose/format/random directions and a wrapper-fragile direct-token endpoint.
No A/B/C component intervention, held-family late-layer causal response matrix, or cross-model factorial mediation outcome has been computed or inspected.

dataset.cell_contract: Every payload_block_id plus purpose_pair_id group contains exactly evaluation/deployment crossed with benchmark/casual on stated rows.
dataset.causal_evaluation_rows: stated rows only; every four-cell group is preserved

factorial_decomposition.fit_scope: mean complete-group effects on direction-role blocks excluding the held purpose family and held payload fold

selection_provenance.rule: among layers with held stated-purpose AUC>=0.80, choose minimum and maximum norm(C)/norm(A), tie by lower layer
map the frozen 8B low/high source layers to identical normalized depths q=5/31 and q=29/31 using floor(q*(n_layers-1)+0.5); no 70B causal-outcome or geometry-extremum selection

activation_contract.baseline_reproduction_gate: For every causal test row, unsteered captured source and target vectors must agree with stored activations within max_abs<=0.125 and cosine>=0.999; otherwise the model is ineligible.

cross_fitting.outer_folds: 5 held purpose families crossed with 5 stable topic-stratified payload folds
cross_fitting.payload_fold_rule: Within each topic, sort payload blocks by SHA256('factorial_causal_payload_fold_v1',topic,block), assign rank mod 5.
cross_fitting.test: held purpose family intersect held payload fold
cross_fitting.training_exclusions: exclude held purpose family and every row from held payload fold
cross_fitting.direction_readout_roles: Within each topic among remaining payload blocks, sort by SHA256('factorial_causal_role_v1',outer_fold,topic,block); alternate direction and readout roles.
cross_fitting.direction_role: fit source-layer A/B/C and residual scale
cross_fitting.readout_role: fit target-layer purpose-benchmark, purpose-casual, and format readouts
cross_fitting.no_overlap: direction, readout, and causal test blocks are disjoint inside each outer fold

readouts.standardization: StandardScaler fit on readout-role training rows only
readouts.purpose_benchmark: evaluation versus deployment on benchmark stated rows
readouts.purpose_casual: evaluation versus deployment on casual stated rows
readouts.format: benchmark versus casual on all stated rows
readouts.score_normalization: divide decision-function shifts by the readout-role training decision-score standard deviation
readouts.baseline_gate: Each format-specific purpose readout and format readout must have pooled causal-test ROC AUC>=0.80 and balanced accuracy>=0.60 before intervention outcomes are interpreted.

interventions.common_residual_scale: median norm of complete-group A vectors on direction-role training groups, separately per model/source-layer/outer-fold
interventions.random_rule: Gaussian direction from fixed seed, project out span(A,B,C), renormalize; the identical direction and norm are used for +/- signs.
interventions.factorial_cube: At alpha=1, also run all eight sign combinations of A,B,C using delta=common_residual_scale*(s_A*unit(A)+s_B*unit(B)+s_C*unit(C)); this is a full intervention response surface, not a single-mediator NIE.
interventions.hook_contract: one post-block hook at the declared source layer; add delta only to the final non-padding prompt token; hook fires exactly once per forward.

causal_estimands.shared_purpose_response: mean of benchmark-purpose and casual-purpose psi
causal_estimands.factorial_cube_estimand: Compare observed held-out endpoint scores at all eight A/B/C intervention corners with the additive prediction from single-component finite differences; report every pairwise and three-way intervention-side interaction rather than interpreting a single-component patch as a unique NIE.
causal_estimands.geometry_causality_prediction: C purpose-interaction response at the high-C/A source layer exceeds the low-C/A source layer.

uncertainty.unit: complete payload block preserving all available held-family four-cell groups

success_criteria.endpoint_valid: all three baseline readouts pass AUC and balanced-accuracy gates in each model
success_criteria.hook_and_reproduction: zero intervention reproduces baseline, every hook fires once, only final prompt token changes, all stored/captured activation gates pass, all outputs finite
success_criteria.A_shared: At primary alpha, A shared-purpose response block-bootstrap CI lower bound >0 and random-control p<=0.05 at both source layers in both models.
success_criteria.C_interaction: At primary alpha, C purpose-interaction response CI lower bound >0 and random-control p<=0.05 at the high-interaction layer in both models.
success_criteria.B_format: At primary alpha, B format response CI lower bound >0 and random-control p<=0.05 at both source layers in both models.
success_criteria.geometry_to_causality: The cross-model aggregate high-minus-low C purpose-interaction response block-bootstrap CI lower bound >0.
success_criteria.dose_response: For each primary component/readout prediction, alpha=0.5 has the same sign and no larger absolute response than alpha=1.0; reported as a robustness gate.
success_criteria.factorial_cube_agreement: The additive single-component response model explains held-out eight-corner response surfaces with pooled R^2>0.50 in each model; every material intervention-side interaction is reported and bounds the causal-component interpretation.
success_criteria.positive: endpoint_valid, hook_and_reproduction, A_shared, C_interaction, B_format, geometry_to_causality, dose_response, and factorial_cube_agreement all pass.
success_criteria.partial: A_shared and at least one of C_interaction/B_format pass with controls, but any other positive gate fails; report internal mediation only without a full factorial-basis claim.
success_criteria.negative: A_shared fails or component responses do not beat matched random controls.

behavioral_secondary.endpoint: deterministic native task generation and exact answer/format compliance on held causal-test rows under baseline,+/-A,+/-format-coded-C at alpha=1
behavioral_secondary.interpretation_gate: baseline parseability>=0.90 and accuracy>=0.40 separately in benchmark and casual; otherwise omit behavioral inference and retain internal causal mediation label
behavioral_secondary.prohibited: No added evaluation/deployment classification wrapper and no post-outcome token/threshold selection.

claim_scope.allowed_if_positive: On the fixed matched pilot80 bank, cross-fitted residual A/B/C components have distinct sign-symmetric downstream internal causal response signatures across held purpose families and payload blocks in Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.3-70B; interaction geometry predicts the layerwise C response.
prohibited: behavioral steering unless the behavioral gate passes
